stories.title: Rivalry Week live: Bo Jackson's big game has Ohio State cruising vs. Michigan
stories.summary: It's the final week of the regular season. Here are the best plays, moments and CFP implications.

stories.title: Falcons cut Tua after 'thoughtful conversations,' end QB's brief Atlanta stint
stories.summary: The Falcons have released Tua Tagovailoa, ending the veteran quarterback's time in Atlanta after less than nine months.

stories.title: Smith continues to rewrite Buckeyes' record book with 18th TD
stories.summary: Jeremiah Smith broke Terry Glenn's Ohio State record with his 18th TD catch of the season and then tied Desmond Howard's Big Ten mark of 19 later in the game.

stories.title: Shiffrin returns to Killington 2 years after crash, takes 2nd in giant slalom
stories.summary: Mikaela Shiffrin finished a giant slalom at Killington in second place as victory eluded the American skiing star in her return to the slope where she endured a painful crash two years ago.

stories.title: Pochettino warns Man United that 'history' won't prevent relegation
stories.summary: Mauricio Pochettino has warned Manchester United that the club is not too big to go down by insisting "you cannot win only with the badge and with the history."
